Summary of the websites shared in #general:
• www.informations.com: The latest jobs report describes a mix of relief and concern as unemployment edged down to 7.2%.
• www.restaurant-zurich.com: Zurich Restaurant offers traditional Swiss cuisine—including cheese fondue, rösti, and chocolate fondue—in a cozy, alpine-inspired setting, with rustic wooden interiors, city skyline views, and staff in traditional Swiss attire.

Hi Dora! I visited www.dora-website.com. The page clearly identifies itself as your personal website and makes your contact email easy to find. Based on the content available, I'd suggest adding a short bio and a few examples of your interests or projects so visitors can get to know you better.

Hi Eve! I visited www.eve-blog.com. Mentioning hiking as your favorite hobby gives the blog a personal touch. Based on the content available, I'd love to see posts about your favorite trails, photos, and practical hiking tips—those would help readers connect with your experiences.
